review_checks.name: gateway_request_lifecycle
review_checks.requirement: The gateway owns request/attempt lifecycle, cancellation, timeout, output commitment and retry policy. Do not infer runtime correctness from static inspection.

review_checks.name: gateway_upstream_separation
review_checks.requirement: The gateway coordinates through explicit interfaces while upstream adapters own network/protocol implementation. Routing owns policy and runtime state without HTTP or SQL; do not require four business layers for algorithms.
